summary: Backend-only retest of iteration-11 fixes (reconcile captured-only + amount guard + awaited sends returning delivery status, resend_log) plus regressions on /api/payments/verify and /api/admin/manual-booking. New pytest file with 13 tests: 13/13 passed. reconcile no-captured path returns ok:false, razorpay_payments:[], message 'No captured payment found on Razorpay for this order' (no 'authorized' wording) and leaves booking pending_payment. resend-ticket returns email_sent/email_error/whatsapp_sent/whatsapp_error (email_sent=true with delivered@resend.dev, whatsapp_sent=false with Twilio trial error string) and appends one {by,at,email_sent,whatsapp_sent} entry to booking.resend_log per call. manual-booking (PRIME26) still returns a confirmed COMP booking and the fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task sends still execute (backend log shows 'Confirmation email ... HTTP 200' and 'WhatsApp send failed' for the new reference) — tuple return did not break existing callers. /api/payments/verify with bad signature returns 400 'Payment verification failed' and does not confirm the booking. Amount-mismatch guard verified by static review (expected_amount / 'Amount mismatch' branch present, only 'captured' accepted). All test bookings deleted (DB back to 1 pre-existing booking).

minor.issue: WhatsApp always fails: Twilio HTTP 400 'trial accounts have limited parameter access' (media_url/QR image not allowed on trial). Endpoint handles it correctly (whatsapp_sent:false + error), but no real WhatsApp ticket delivery is possible until the Twilio account is upgraded.
Still missing (known backlog item). Payment reconciliation continues to depend on manual admin action, so the original EO-2S4IQ7 class of bug can recur.

action_items: Implement the Razorpay webhook (payment.captured) so confirmation/ticket delivery no longer requires manual admin reconcile.
Upgrade/whitelist Twilio WhatsApp (or drop media_url on trial) — WhatsApp delivery currently fails 100% of the time.

Optional: run twilio_client.messages.create in a thread (asyncio.to_thread) — it is a blocking sync HTTP call inside async reconcile/resend handlers and now blocks the event loop since sends are awaited.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 1405 lines — split into routers (payments, admin, tickets/pdf, notifications).
send_whatsapp_confirmation uses the blocking Twilio SDK inside an async handler; with the new awaited sends this stalls the event loop for the duration of two Twilio calls.
reconcile/resend duplicate the same 'await email + await whatsapp + build delivery-status dict' block — extract a helper to keep the two responses in sync.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 pending_payment booking (real Razorpay order) and 2 COMP bookings with email delivered@resend.dev; all deleted in session teardown and verified removed from MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Happy-path reconcile (ok:true) and the amount-mismatch branch still cannot be exercised end-to-end without a real captured Razorpay payment (LIVE keys, real money) — only static review was done. Reuse fixtures in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_reconcile_delivery_status.py. Use email delivered@resend.dev for guaranteed email success; WhatsApp will always report false on the trial Twilio account.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (paid booking stuck unbilled, no ticket email) was caused by reliance on the browser calling /payments/verify with no webhook fallback. The admin reconcile/resend endpoints now provide a manual recovery path with visible per-channel delivery status; the root cause (no webhook) remains open.
